subject: Pilot demo timing & procurement window
messages:
From: Leah Martinez <leah@evergreen.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot demo: timing + procurement window

Hi David / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick follow-up after last week's intro. We are very interested in running the pilot, but a few scheduling constraints have come up on our side that may push the demo window out. Our CFO moved the FY planning offsite to the week of June 14 and several procurement stakeholders (and our CTO) will be traveling the first half of June.

Two asks from me:
- Can you share a couple of mid-July slots you could hold tentatively? We want to align the demo with the post-budget meeting so decision-makers can attend.
- I'm attaching a short pilot scope + our procurement checklist for context (pilot_scope.pdf). Procurement will want an early look at the SOW and pricing cadence.

We'd like to avoid a rushed demo without the CFO and head of platform, so pushing until after the budget week is probably best. Happy to do a brief sync with your AE and solutions architect beforehand if that helps.

Best,
Leah
Leah Martinez
Head of Data & Analytics
Evergreen Analytics
Attachment: pilot_scope.pdf (application/pdf)

--

Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo: timing + procurement window

Leah — thanks for the heads up and the scope doc. Appreciate the context.

We're flexible on the exact day, and mid-July works from our side. To make this easy for scheduling, here are a few provisional slots that we can hold for Evergreen (all US Eastern):
- Tue, Jul 13: 9:30–11:00am (deep-dive + Q&A)
- Wed, Jul 14: 1:00–2:30pm (compact walkthrough + exec summary)
- Thu, Jul 22: 10:00–11:30am (backup)

Quick clarifications that will help us tailor the session:
- Who are the must-attend stakeholders for the demo? You mentioned CFO + head of platform — any others (procurement lead, security)?
- Will you want a short procurement-focused appendix (SLA, data handling, audit logs) included in the demo? Neha can bring the compliance checklist.

We can also do a 30-minute pre-demo sync the week prior with our solutions architect to align expectations and walk through the success criteria for the pilot. I'll mark these slots tentatively on our side but won't block calendars until you confirm.

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Martinez <leah@evergreen.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 15:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo: timing + procurement window

Leah — quick note on internal availability and a suggested cadence.

Thanks for flagging the CFO offsite. We track a lot of these customers who tie pilots to their internal FY planning and it usually works best to have two things lined up: an internal stakeholder presence for the initial demo (CFO/Head of Platform + 1 technical PM) and a separate procurement review session where we go through SOW and T&Cs.

From our side, David and I are out for part of the week of June 7 for conference travel, and Neha is running a SOC2 prep workshop on June 10–11. So, holding anything in the first half of June will be brittle. Mid-July as David suggested is sensible; if it helps, propose we hold a 45-minute procurement-only slot the week after the demo so their procurement team can digest the SOW and return comments.

I've created a quick availability poll to make selecting a date easier: https://doodle.com/poll/evergreen-demo-availability — can you ask the core attendees to respond by Friday 6/4?

Also, Leah — can you confirm the procurement decision deadline? If you expect a buy/no-buy decision within 30 days of the demo that helps our rollout and pricing guidance.

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Neha to prepare the compliance appendix.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Leah Martinez <leah@evergreen.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Evergreen Analytics Procurement <procurement@evergreen.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo: timing + procurement window

David / Marissa — thanks for the flexible options and for creating the poll. CFO will be back the week of July 11, so mid-July looks good. Procurement also asked that we tentatively hold a 90-minute slot the week of July 12–16 so the exec summary + technical deep-dive can happen together (they prefer to see everything in one session).

We responded to the doodle — attendees from our side will be: CFO (T. Green), CTO (S. Patel), Head of Platform (L. Morgan), Procurement Lead (A. Ruiz), and me. Procurement wants to see an initial SOW and draft pricing so I've attached a preliminary SOW (SOW-draft.docx) for your review.

Decision timeline: procurement expects to return redlines within two weeks of the demo, and finance needs a formal cost estimate to include in the July reforecast.

Can you tentatively hold Tue Jul 13 09:30 and Wed Jul 14 13:00 on your side? We'll confirm final date by EOD 6/11 after the core attendees respond to the poll.

Appreciate the help — talk soon.

Leah
Head of Data & Analytics
Evergreen Analytics
